data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by $5.018 million in 2017, primarily driven by adverse development in some lines, as indicated by the gross claims development triangle. This strengthening occurred despite some favorable developments in Professional Indemnity and Energy portfolios. The year was significantly impacted by current year natural catastrophe events such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, and Californian wildfires, as well as large man-made losses in the Hull account. A large loss from a Brazilian plane crash in 2016 also continued to affect the Aviation account.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate was exposed to losses arising out of Hurricanes, Harvey, Irma and Maria.
The most significant losses were incurred in Marine XL which made a loss of $3.3m... almost entirely the result of the hurricanes which has cost the class an estimated $13.0m.
Property XL's underwriting profit... limit the impact of the hurricanes to $10.2m and the Californian wildfires to $2.9m.

Professional Indemnity... significantly reduced its losses from $11.2m in 2016 to $1.3m. Following the in-depth analysis into previous heavy back-year claims experience, which did not identify any systemic issue and highlighted that the majority of losses had arisen in areas that were no longer a focus of the book, it was encouraging that there were no such further deterioration in 2017.
The $14.4m profit in Energy was an excellent result... particularly notable for its sustained turnaround... demonstrating the success of re-underwriting in the book in recent years.

Hull incurred hurricane losses of $5.5m, mostly relating to Caribbean yachts destroyed by Irma. Beyond this there were a number of large losses including the sinking of the Stellar Daisy cargo ship and the sinking of the new Seikongen fishing vessel among others.
The hurricanes contributed losses after reinstatements of $7.3m to the division, on top of an unusually high level of large losses in the Hull account which had a particularly difficult year.
a large loss resulting from a Brazilian plane crash prevented it from achieving profitability again this year
